fullContentHtml:
MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the admit card for the post of Group-2 Sub Group -1 Krashi Vistar Adhikari (Agriculture Extension Officer AEO). This recruitment was released for 2784 posts. The online application process for MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 03 July 2026, to 17 July 2026. The Exam is going to conducted on 17 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 22 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 17 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS : Rs. 310/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 310/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
